# 2013: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 4,991 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2013.sqlite](2013.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `94e024ade112708d4c24c5ce035e5b1e68e775d210f1f135dea860bb4108a49b`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.2`. Date: 2026-10-22.

Original entries without attached citations: 42. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 17; partial: 25; without a full-event review: 4,949. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2013-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359119110](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2013%20January%201&oldid=1359119110>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2013-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Fierce clashes erupt near the Aleppo International Airport in the battle of Aleppo in Syria, with unconfirmed reports it has been temporarily closed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-20882790>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-0-3"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill five female teachers and two other people in an ambush on a van carrying workers home from their jobs at a community center in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDefault/*/Article_2013-01-01-Pakistan/id-65d08fc9a1af44898875257bf79d6271>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-20880948>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict:.

**Archived source account.** 13 FARC members are killed in an airstrike by the Colombian military.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-20884906>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Nigerian Sharia conflict:.

**Archived source account.** Nigeria's military kill 13 members of the Islamist militant group Boko Haram and lose one soldier in a gun battle in Maiduguri.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2013/01/01/uk-nigeria-violence-idUKBRE90009V20130101>); [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130104093612/http://english.ruvr.ru/2013_01_02/Nigerian-military-wipe-out-13-Islamists-in-north-east-of-country/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2013-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American 1950s pop singer Patti Page, best known for the Tennessee Waltz and (How Much Is That) Doggie In The Window dies in Encinitas, California.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC San Diego](<http://www.nbcsandiego.com/news/local/Patti-Page-Died-Encinitas-Rancho-Santa-Fe-185415202.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2013-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 2013 Houphouët-Boigny stampede: At least 60 people are killed and more than 200 injured in a stampede during a New Year's fireworks celebration near the Stade Félix Houphouët-Boigny in Abidjan, Ivory Coast.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-20881552>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2013/01/01/world/africa/ivory-coast-deaths>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/01/01/us-ivorycoast-stadium-idUSBRE90003Z20130101>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Royal Dutch Shell's drilling rig Kulluk drifts aground near Sitkalidak Island, Alaska, after breaking loose from the anchor handling tug Aiviq.

Source citations (as archived): [Anchorage Daily News](<http://www.adn.com/2012/12/31/2739314/shell-drilling-rig-is-adrift-again.html>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nation/nationnow/la-na-nn-shell-kulluk-grounded-20130101,0,7770041.story>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A head-on collision between a bus and a minibus occurred in Thiès, Senegal, killing at least 18 people and leaving another 16 wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.ndtv.com/article/world/senegal-road-accident-kills-18-312138>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed and 120 injured in a stampede in Luanda, Angola, as they tried to enter an overcrowded Estádio da Cidadela for a New Year's Eve vigil.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-20885821>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gg7AqaXONd_Na0OknrdjVdLxH4Zw>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2013-01-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentina, Australia, Luxembourg, Rwanda and South Korea join the UN Security Council.

Source citations (as archived): [News24](<http://www.news24.com/Africa/News/Rwanda-vows-to-help-on-DRC-at-UN-20130101>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Kingdom assumes presidency of G8 group. Next G8 summit is to be held on the shores of Lough Erne in Northern Ireland in June 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-20880368>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2013-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and three wounded in a shooting in Sacramento during the New Year's Eve celebrations.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2013/01/01/sacramento-police-say-2-dead-3-hurt-in-shooting/>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2013/01/01/us/california-new-years-eve-shooting/>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130104094512/http://www.sacbee.com/2012/12/31/5085810/sacramento-police-say-2-dead-3.html>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Celebratory gunfire kills a four-year-old boy and more than 400 others are injured by powerful firecrackers in typically rowdy New Year celebrations in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gxH_j1yHpIoeUZxiynsXfyXgWdqg>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Similar to numbers in previous years, 1193 empty parked cars are set on fire during New Year's Eve 'celebrations' across France.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://news.yahoo.com/france-counts-1-193-cars-torched-years-eve-202547572.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2013-01-01-5-1"></a>

Context: United States "fiscal cliff" debate:.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate bipartisanly approves a deal to avert general tax hikes and spending cuts known as the "fiscal cliff".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-20880755>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/01/01/us-usa-fiscal-idUSBRE8A80WV20130101>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2013/01/01/senate-leaders-aim-for-vote-on-fiscal-crisis-deal-as-congress-misses-deadline/>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-5-2"></a>

Context: United States "fiscal cliff" debate:.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives approves the "fiscal cliff" deal, with Republican Speaker of the House John Bohener breaking with his party to vote "yes". Before the vote took place, congressional members were unsure whether or not the deal would be approved after House Majority Leader Eric Cantor announced his opposition to the deal, and other House Republicans raised concerns about it.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://politicalticker.blogs.cnn.com/2013/01/01/latest-updates-house-readies-for-fiscal-cliff-vote>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/us-politics/9774979/Fiscal-cliff-US-House-of-Representatives-approves-deal.html>); [New York Post](<http://www.nypost.com/p/news/national/fiscal_cliff_deal_approved_house_DXAki3A2tPMkLvlCcEqDEL>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea's leader Kim Jong-un makes a rare New Year broadcast, calling for an improved economy and a reunified Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-20880301>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/01/01/us-korea-north-idUSBRE90001S20130101>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prince William, Duke of Cambridge, as part of his military duties, pilots a Royal Air Force (RAF) Sea King helicopter which was sent out in the early morning hours to an as of yet unsuccessful search for a Blackpool, England man swept out to sea there.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://todaynews.today.com/_news/2013/01/02/16304408-prince-william-leads-rescue-attempt-at-sea-on-new-years-day>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2013-01-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Santos FC striker Neymar is named as 2012 South American Footballer of the Year, running ahead of Paolo Guerrero and Lucas Moura.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://soccernet.espn.go.com/columns/story/_/id/1284188/neymar:-south-america&#x27;s-finest-footballer-in-2012>); [HDTV Sports](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130102013232/http://sports.ndtv.com/football/news/item/201360-neymar-voted-south-americas-best-player>); [Sambafoot](<http://www.sambafoot.com/en/news/40964_neymar_voted_best_player_in_south_america_2012_-_el_pais.html>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In chess, the world number one Magnus Carlsen achieves the highest-ever FIDE official rating (2861) based on Elo rating system, breaking Garry Kasparov's 13-year record.

Source citations (as archived): [FIDE](<http://ratings.fide.com/top.phtml?list=men>); [ChessBase](<http://www.chessbase.com/newsdetail.asp?newsid=8744>); [ABC.es](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130106160329/http://www.abc.es/agencias/noticia.asp?noticia=1324537>).

<a id="event-2013-01-01-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Srečko Katanec is appointed Slovenia national football team coach, replacing Slaviša Stojanovič.

Source citations (as archived): [UEFA](<http://www.uefa.com/worldcup/news/newsid=1909686.html>); [HRsport.net](<http://www.hrsport.net/vijesti/453343/nogomet-nogometni-svijet/srecko-katanec-ponovno-na-klupi-slovenije/>).

#### Transportation

<a id="event-2013-01-01-7-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Cheng Lim began passenger service on January 1, 2013, on Sengkang LRT's West Loop.

Editorial date: 2013-01-01. Checked: 2026-10-22. The station history and line identification support the archived assertion.

Evidence: [Land Transport Guru](<https://landtransportguru.net/cheng-lim-station/>).

Original source account: Cheng Lim LRT station opened along the West Loop of the Sengkang LRT line.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

### 2013-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076368565](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2013%20January%202&oldid=1076368565>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2013-01-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** An airstrike on a petrol station outside the capital Damascus kills and injures dozens of people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2013/01/201312111453479410.html>).

<a id="event-2013-01-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations says the death toll from the conflict could be more than 60,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [UN](<http://www.un.org/apps/news/story.asp?NewsID=43866&amp;Cr=syria>).

<a id="event-2013-01-02-0-4"></a>

Context: 2012 Central African Republic rebellion:.

**Archived source account.** Rebels halt their advance towards the capital Bangui and agree to peace talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/01/02/us-car-rebels-talks-idUSBRE90105C20130102>).

<a id="event-2013-01-02-0-5"></a>

Context: 2012 Central African Republic rebellion:.

**Archived source account.** President François Bozizé fires both his army chief of staff and his son, Jean Francis Bozizé, as defense minister, taking the ministerial position for himself.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130107032116/http://www.voanews.com/content/central-african-republic-bozize-fires-defense-minister-army-chief/1576693.html>).

<a id="event-2013-01-02-0-7"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan:.

**Archived source account.** An airstrike kills Maulvi Nazir, leader of the Pakistani Taliban along with five others in Angoor Ada near the capital of Wana, South Waziristan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-20896755>).

<a id="event-2013-01-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Kachin conflict:.

### 2013-01-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076368332](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2013%20January%207&oldid=1076368332>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2013-01-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** For $8.5 billion, ten banks settle to stop mortgage foreclosure process audits. The United States government regulators had been engaged in a loan-by-loan review of home loan practices during the Great Recession. Bank of America, Citigroup Inc, JPMorgan Chase &amp; Co, Wells Fargo &amp; Co, MetLife Bank, Aurora Bank FSB, PNC Financial Services Group Inc, Sovereign Bank NA, SunTrust Banks Inc, and U.S. Bancorp settle with regulators to pay out cash up to $125,000 to homeowners whose homes were being foreclosed when the paperwork problems emerged. Further, Bank of America agrees to pay $11.6 billion to government mortgage finance company Fannie Mae.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/01/07/us-bofa-msrs-sale-idUSBRE9060D220130107>).

Pope Benedict urges an end to the “slaughter” in Syria and stresses the “grave responsibility” to work for peace around the world.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-asks-diplomats-to-seek-peace-appeals-for-syria>).

### 2013-01-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076367785](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2013%20January%2017&oldid=1076367785>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-1"></a>

Context: In Aménas hostage crisis:.

**Archived source account.** An Algerian official reports that a group of hostages has escaped from the natural gas complex that was taken over by Islamist militants. It is reported as many as 20 escaped, including Americans.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-21054521>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/news/nationworld/world/la-20-foreign-hostages-escape-islamist-captors-in-algeria-20130117,0,7004240.story>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2013/01/17/us-france-reportedly-in-talks-with-algeria-over-hostage-standoff/>).

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-2"></a>

Context: In Aménas hostage crisis:.

**Archived source account.** The Algerian Army assaults the complex with helicopter gunships, reportedly killing 15 kidnappers and as many as 34 hostages. According to local sources, at least 7 hostages remain alive and in captivity.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2013/01/201311713160194432.html>).

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-3"></a>

Context: In Aménas hostage crisis:.

**Archived source account.** Algerian news agency ANP reports that during the Algerian Army assault 600 hostages were freed. Terrorists claim that they killed 35 hostages during the battle and that 15 terrorists were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2013/01/17/algeria-hostages/1841343/>).

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** 106 people are massacred in the Basatin al-Hasawiya district of Homs, Syria, including children. People were shot, stabbed, and burned to death by forces loyal to Bashar al-Assad known as the Shabiha.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/01/17/us-syria-crisis-idUSBRE90G09R20130117>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-21073447>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2013/01/201311716944605506.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2013/jan/17/homs-massacre-syria-basatin-hasawiya>).

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-7"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict (2012–present):.

**Archived source account.** The number of French forces in the country rises to 1,400, more than half of the planned 2,500 strong force, as its troops continue to fight insurgents in Konna and Diabaly. Chad prepares to send the first 200 troops of a 2000-strong force to assist in the military operations as part of a regional mission. The European Union votes to send 450 to 500 "non-combat" troops to Mali, half of them are trainers.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2013/01/2013117114015728807.html>).

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-8"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict (2012–present):.

**Archived source account.** The first West African troops enter Mali. 100 soldiers from the Togolese military enter the country with Nigerian military due to enter shortly afterward.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/01/17/us-mali-rebels-idUSBRE90D0FX20130117>).

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-10"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (post-U.S. withdrawal):.

**Archived source account.** Two car bombs explode in the city of Dujail, Iraq, leaving at least 7 dead and 25 wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/world/2013-01/17/c_132109650.htm>).

<a id="event-2013-01-17-0-11"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (post-U.S. withdrawal):.

**Archived source account.** A bomb detonated on a bus carrying pilgrims in Iraq. In a separate incident a roadside bomb detonated and injures two pilgrims walking to Hussein ibn Ali. Another bomb detonated at a bus stop killing 7 people and wounding 28. Also a civilian vehicle was hit by a roadside bomb leaving 2 dead. In total 33 people were killed in one of the most violent days this month.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2013-01-21-0-4"></a>

This follows the recent controversy over a new cover for Sylvia Plath's The Bell Jar which portrays a young woman applying make-up.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2013-04-09-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Downing Street announces the funeral for Margaret Thatcher is scheduled for Wednesday, 17 April. She will be afforded a ceremonial exit, ranking her alongside Diana Spencer and the Queen Mother.

<a id="event-2013-04-09-5-2"></a>

Context: Thatcher funeral events:.

**Archived source account.** Tony Blair, who continued many of Thatcher's policies, expresses irritation at the response to her death, claiming people are being disrespectful. Blair appears on CNN to reveal his admiration for his predecessor, calling her "a huge figure, a towering figure."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-22080238>); [CNN](<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RQas4mTbgcQ>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/football/2013/apr/09/real-madrid-galatasaray-champions-league>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/22070501>); [UEFA](<http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/season=2013/matches/round=2000349/match=2009607/index.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2013-04-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Boston Marathon bombings:.

**Archived source account.** The Boston Police Department chases two carjacking suspects in the MIT shooting death of a campus policeman to the nearby suburb of Watertown where, after a gunfight that included explosives, an MBTA officer is injured, one suspect is dead, and the other flees but is later captured.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston Herald](<http://bostonherald.com/news_opinion/local_coverage/2013/04/mit_police_officer_killed_cops_chase_suspects_in_watertown>).

<a id="event-2013-04-19-0-2"></a>

Context: Boston Marathon bombings:.

**Archived source account.** The suspects are brothers. The at-large suspect is identified as a Kyrgyzstan-born Cambridge resident, 19-year-old Dzhokhar Tsarnaev. The deceased brother is identified as 26-year-old Tamerlan Tsarnaev. A number of YouTube videos, posted by the suspects, surface that seek Muslim takeover of Chechnya.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.wtsp.com/news/topstories/article/312057/250/AP-Surviving-bomb-suspect-identified>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2013/04/19/bombing-suspects-followed-harry-potter-hating-australian-sheikh/>).

<a id="event-2013-04-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Boston Marathon bombings:.

**Archived source account.** Boston and its suburbs are on lockdown as a result of the manhunt. People were not allowed to go out until the lockdown was lifted, and businesses were also closed.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston Herald](<http://bostonherald.com/news_opinion/local_coverage/2013/04/boston_surrounding_communities_on_lockdown>); [NBC News](<http://usnews.nbcnews.com/_news/2013/04/19/17823265-boston-on-lockdown-as-details-pour-in-suspects-told-carjack-victim-they-were-marathon-bombers>).

<a id="event-2013-04-19-0-4"></a>

Context: Boston Marathon bombings:.

**Archived source account.** Shortly after officials announce that they have lost track of the suspect and lifted the lockdown, a tip leads police to the back yard of a home in the Boston suburb of Watertown, Massachusetts, where the second suspect is captured after an exchange of gunfire and a brief standoff.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2013/apr/19/boston-mit-police-dead-watertown>).

<a id="event-2013-04-19-0-5"></a>

Context: Boston Marathon bombings:.

**Archived source account.** Dzhokhar Tsarnaev is captured and taken in serious condition to Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. #### Sports

<a id="event-2013-04-30-4-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The April 30 AP preview described Los Angeles entering the playoffs after winning its first Stanley Cup the previous spring.

Editorial date: 2013-04-30. Checked: 2026-10-22. The opened passage supports the defending-champion context. A complete official tournament calendar was not opened to independently establish the first date of the whole playoff schedule.

Evidence: [Associated Press via CBS Baltimore](<https://www.cbsnews.com/baltimore/news/kings-prepare-for-another-playoff-round-with-blues/>).

Original source account: The 2013 Stanley Cup playoffs begin, with the Los Angeles Kings attempting to defend their 2012 Stanley Cup title.\{\{citation needed\|date=May 2013\}\}

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2013-05-14-3-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Beyonce canceled Antwerp on medical advice; the replacement concert was scheduled for May 31.

Editorial date: 2013-05-14. Checked: 2026-10-22. CBS/AP reported exhaustion/dehydration and the consecutive bookings. Podiuminfo documented the revised date.

Evidence: [CBS / Associated Press](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/beyonce-cancels-show-under-doctors-orders/>); [Podiuminfo](<https://www.podiuminfo.nl/news/26218/Nieuwe-datum-voor-concert-Beyonce-in-Sportpaleis/>).

Original source account: Due to dehydration and exhaustion, Beyoncé cancels night one of what was to be two consecutive nights performing in Antwerp, Belgium, on the Mrs. Carter Show World Tour; reschedules it to May 31, 2013.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Roberts, the Commanding General of the U.S. Army Training Center, Fort Jackson (South Carolina), is suspended from his duties because of an investigation into alleged adultery (which is treated as a criminal violation, not just a civil matter, in the U.S. military), and for allegedly being in a physical altercation.

The rescue effort was suspended for the night, after conditions got worse.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2013-06-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Guardian obtains a copy of a court order signed on April 25 by Judge Roger Vinson of the secret Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court (FISC). The order permits the FBI, and thereby the Obama administration, to indiscriminately collect phone records of millions of Verizon Communications customers on an "ongoing, daily basis", with all domestic and international calls affected. The permit is similar to one issued to the Bush administration. The Guardian's report does not state from whom they obtained the document.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2013/jun/06/nsa-phone-records-verizon-court-order>).

<a id="event-2013-06-06-4-2"></a>

Context: PRISM (U.S. government surveillance program):.

**Archived source account.** The Guardian obtains a copy of a document from April that reveals that the NSA is mining data using PRISM, spying on the e-mails and web activities of American citizens through direct access to Google, Apple, Microsoft, Facebook, YouTube, Skype, Yahoo, Paltalk and AOL. The Guardian's report does not state from whom they obtained the document.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2013/06/06/nsa-surveillance-internet-companies/2398345/>); [PC World](<http://www.pcworld.com/article/2040991/report-nsa-prism-program-spied-on-americans-emails-searches.html>); [The Guardian](<http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2013/jun/06/us-tech-giants-nsa-data>).

**Archived source account.** The Obama administration defends its secret surveillance policies.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/americas/2013/06/201366113050371205.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2013-07-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** France and Portugal refuse to allow the plane of Bolivian President Evo Morales to land on their respective territories after suspicions that Edward Snowden was on board.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/bolivian-minister-evo-morales-plane-rerouted-to-austria-on-suspicion-snowden-on-board/2013/07/02/af7a3eb4-e366-11e2-bffd-37a36ddab820_story.html>).

<a id="event-2013-07-02-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Wales becomes the first country in the UK to adopt a presumed consent system of organ donation after members of its legislative assembly vote in favour of the system.

<a id="event-2013-07-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Portuguese political crisis, 2013:.

**Archived source account.** Portuguese Minister of Foreign Affairs Paulo Portas quits after disagreeing with the prime minister's choice for Finance Minister, Maria Luís Albuquerque. The Minister for the Environment and Agriculture and the Minister of Social Security are also set to resign.,

Source citations (as archived): [Euro news](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2013-07-02/portugal-foreign-minister-quits-over-choice-of-finance-minister.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-23146635>).

<a id="event-2013-07-02-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Communist Party of Cuba announces a shakeup of its leadership with former President of the National Assembly of People's Power Ricardo Alarcón and several others losing roles on the Central Committee.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/cuba-announces-shakeup-party-leadership>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2013-07-05-6-1"></a>

Context: Portuguese political crisis, 2013.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** RTP reported that Portas conditioned remaining in government on finance minister Maria Luis Albuquerque leaving office.

Editorial date: 2013-07-05. Checked: 2026-10-22. This was an attributed negotiation report. The opened text does not establish the separate claim that President Cavaco Silva demanded this outcome.

Evidence: [RTP / Antena1](<https://www.rtp.pt/noticias/politica/paulo-portas-so-aceita-ficar-se-maria-luis-albuquerque-deixar-cargo-nas-financas_a664421>).

Original source account: Minister of Foreign Affairs Paulo Portas reportedly gives an ultimatum to the Prime Minister asking to exonerate the Minister of Finance Maria Luís Albuquerque in order to keep the first in the Government, as the President Cavaco Silva has demanded.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2013-07-05-6-2"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The PCP parliamentary group demanded an explanation on July 4 for Portugal refusing overflight and landing to President Morales's aircraft.

Editorial date: 2013-07-05. Checked: 2026-10-22. This primary partisan document establishes the dispute and parliamentary demand. The alleged July 5 vote rejecting an apology was not independently verified; the party's characterization is attributed, not endorsed.

Evidence: [Portuguese Communist Party parliamentary group](<https://www.pcp.pt/sobre-impedimento-do-sobrevoo-aterragem-do-aviao-presidencial-da-republica-da-bolivia>).

Original source account: The Portuguese Parliament votes down a motion to apologize to the Government of Bolivia for not allowing the plane carrying President Evo Morales to land and fly over Portuguese national airspace.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2013-07-05-6-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/zimbabwe-sets-election-date-20130705-2pft3.html>).

### 2013-07-06

#### Arts and Culture

**Archived source account.** 16-year-old Hannah Anderson was abducted after cheerleading practice from Sweetwater High School in National City, California. The bodies of her mother Christina and brother Ethan Anderson and the family's dog, Cali, were found in DiMaggio's burned home. DiMaggio was later killed by FBI agents during a shootout at the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness in Idaho, where he had been camping with Hannah Anderson.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Colombia's park authority dates resolution 1038 to August 21, 2013, expanding Chiribiquete from roughly 1.299 million to 2.782 million hectares.

Editorial date: 2013-08-18. Checked: 2026-10-22. This qualifies the source's rounded areas. The August 18 announcement and connection to Ecuador's Yasuni decision are not established by the opened park history; announcement and legal resolution can differ.

Evidence: [Parques Nacionales Naturales de Colombia](<https://old.parquesnacionales.gov.co/portal/es/parques-nacionales/parque-nacional-natural-chiribiquete/>).

Original source account: Chiribiquete National Park, in Colombia, is expanded from its previous 1.2 Million Hectares to 3 Million Hectares becoming one of the largest protected zones in the Amazon. This announcement was made by the Colombian government after Ecuador decided to open up Yasuni National Park to oil drilling after a six year initiative to protect the rain forest.\{\{citation needed\|date=January 2015\}\}

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2013-08-27-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Russia has begun to evacuate its citizens from Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/10268547/Syria-Russia-evacuates-citizens-ahead-of-military-strikes-in-the-next-few-days.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2013-08-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Rim Fire near Yosemite National Park has now grown to about 281 square miles.

Source citations (as archived): [Southern California Public Radio](<http://www.scpr.org/news/2013/08/27/38900/rim-fire-yosemite-wildfire-now-7th-largest-in-cali/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2013-08-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The riots between two religious communities started at Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, India.

Source citations (as archived): [Biharprabha](<http://news.biharprabha.com/2013/09/what-triggered-the-deadly-riots-in-muzaffarnagar/>).

### 2013-08-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076304924](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2013%20August%2028&oldid=1076304924>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Moscow evacuates nationals; Iran dismisses "ridiculous" reports of Assad in Tehran; UN inspectors return to site of alleged chemical attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times Of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/syria-said-to-clear-out-security-installations-ahead-of-attack/>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The Saudi army is on full alert after the US-led West increased the level of its threats and said a strike on Syria may come within the next few days.

Source citations (as archived): [Fars News](<http://english.farsnews.com/newstext.aspx?nn=13920606000908>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Russia: UN response to alleged attack still premature; Jordan says no Syria strike from its soil.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/1.543986>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** United Nations Special Envoy to Syria Lakhdar Brahimi says any military action against Syria in response to apparent chemical attacks must be taken after a decision by the United Nations Security Council. "What they \[American administration\] will decide I don't know, but certainly international law is very clear," he adds.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/08/28/us-syria-crisis-brahimi-idUSBRE97R0EW20130828>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** US Vice President Joe Biden says there "is no doubt that Syria's government was responsible for a recent chemical attack in Damascus".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2013/08/201382825511534906.html>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister David Cameron says the UK's National Security Council has agreed that the "world should not stand by" after the "unacceptable use" of chemical weapons by the Syrian government. However, a full report from the UN investigation on the chemical attack is expected before taking any measure.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-23864016>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Syrians in the capital Damascus race against time to prepare for a foreign strike, with many hoarding supplies and others scrambling to find accommodation further away from potential military targets.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/08/28/us-syria-crisis-strike-civilians-idUSBRE97R0UJ20130828>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Russian and Chinese officials walk out of the UN Security Council meeting in New York after U.S. Permanent Representative Samantha Power calls for immediate action on Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Itar Tass](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130830193111/http://pda.itar-tass.com/en/c32/856318.html>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Downing Street publishes the UK government's motion on Syria, which proposes waiting for a UN Security Council decision before MPs vote on any military action.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-23870810>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** UN chemical weapons inspectors resume their investigations in Syria

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-23861895>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Syria's deputy foreign minister says that the United States, Britain and France helped "terrorists" use chemical weapons in Syria, and that the same groups would soon use them against Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/08/28/us-syria-crisis-europe-idUSBRE97R0N220130828>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-12"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Syria's ambassador to the United Nations accuses Britain of conspiring with rebel forces to carry out the chemical attack that killed hundreds of Syrian civilians last week.

Source citations (as archived): [Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/10272380/Syrias-UN-ambassador-accuses-Britain-of-conspiring-with-rebels-in-chemical-weapons-attack.html>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-0-14"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (post-U.S. withdrawal):.

**Archived source account.** At least 51 people are killed and dozens wounded in a series of bombings and attacks in and around Baghdad.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/1134051/baghdad-bombings-at-least-51-people-killed>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2013-08-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The eastern span of the San Francisco Bay Bridge closes forever as construction crews finish the replacement. The new span is scheduled to open Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130830194539/http://abclocal.go.com/kgo/story?section=resources%2Ftraffic&amp;id=9221668>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2013-08-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Coptic Catholic Patriarch of Alexandria Ibrahim Isaac Sidrak warns foreign leaders not to use protecting Christians as an excuse to intervene in the current political violence in Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Service](<http://www.catholicnews.com/data/stories/cns/1303695.htm>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2013-08-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. Army Major and psychiatrist Nidal Malik Hasan is sentenced to death for the November 5, 2009, Fort Hood massacre that killed 13 and wounded 32 others. He will be granted an automatic appeal; the Army general (convening authority) who will review the case can grant him life without parole; any eventual military execution would need presidential approval.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2013/08/28/us/nidal-hasan-sentencing/index.html?hpt=hp_c2>).

<a id="event-2013-08-28-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran pursues the 1953 Iranian coup d'état case, which was orchestrated by US and Britain, in the international courts at The Hague. CIA officially admitted role in the coup on 20 August 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Fars News](<http://english.farsnews.com/newstext.aspx?nn=13920606001389>).

### 2013-08-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076304882](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2013%20August%2029&oldid=1076304882>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The French frigate Chevalier Paul leaves the port city of Toulon, though the shipping authorities declined to confirm a media report that it was headed to Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/08/29/us-syria-crisis-hollande-idUSBRE97S0CU20130829>); [Voice of Russia](<http://voiceofrussia.com/2013_08_29/France-issues-out-most-up-to-date-naval-vessel-to-Syria-6608/?from=menu>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of the United Kingdom defeats a government motion supporting intervention in the war by 13 votes, effectively ruling out British military involvement in an international response to the chemical attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-23892783>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** French President François Hollande says "political solution" is the ultimate goal for Syria, sounding more cautious than earlier. "Everything must be done for a political solution but it will only happen if the coalition is able to appear as an alternative with the necessary force, notably from its army," he said.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/08/29/us-syria-crisis-hollande-idUSBRE97S0CU20130829>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Russia sends two warships to the eastern Mediterranean.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/08/29/us-syria-crisis-russia-navy-idUSBRE97S0AK20130829>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Lebanon and Jordan say the Lebanese air space and the Jordanian territories would not be made available for military intervention in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/video/2013-08/29/c_132672994.htm>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Allegations are made that the lines between Hezbollah and the Syrian regime are so blurred that Israel will hold Damascus responsible if Hezbollah bombards Israel in the coming days.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Defense/Israel-will-hold-Assad-responsible-if-Hezbollah-attacks-324615>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** A Kuwaiti newspaper reports that Gulf leaders have been in touch with Israel, and have asked that Israel act “with restraint” in the event of an attack by Western nations on Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Israel National News](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/171397#.Uh818hswf4S>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Britain is sending six Typhoon fighter jets to Cyprus to guard against potential retaliation by the Assad regime in the event of air strikes against Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/middleeast/syria/10273157/Syria-crisis-Britain-sends-six-Typhoon-fighter-jets-to-Cyprus-ahead-of-military-strikes.html>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war:.

**Archived source account.** Britain's Joint Intelligence Committee concludes it is "highly likely" that the regime of Bashar al-Assad was responsible for the chemical weapons attacks in Syria last week that have prompted moves towards launching military strikes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/aug/29/uk-intelligence-syrian-regime-chemical-weapons>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-0-11"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2013 Korean crisis:.

**Archived source account.** North Korea warns against an underway joint military drill by South Korea and the United States, stating that the exercise could jeopardize a recent easing of tension on the Korean Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/2013-08-29/north-korea-says-u-s-threatens-nuclear-attack-with-b-52-bombers.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/08/29/zurich-cfo-ackermann-idUSL6N0GU09F20130829?feedType=RSS>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASDAQ OMX issues a preliminary report on the halt in NASDAQ-listed equities and options that took place on August 22. \{\{Dead link\|date=November 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

#### Health

<a id="event-2013-08-29-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 8.6 million Americans take prescription sleeping pills to catch some sleep, according to the first federal health study to focus on actual use.

<a id="event-2013-08-29-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists at Vienna's Institute of Molecular Biotechnology and Edinburgh University's Human Genetics Unit in Edinburgh, Scotland, clone a human mini-brain (a cerebral organoid), using stem cells; the first time brain tissue development has been replicated in three dimensions – which could help with schizophrenia and autism neurological research.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20130831065700/http://news.msn.com/science-technology/scientists-grow-mini-human-brains-from-stem-cells>).

<a id="event-2013-08-29-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Rim Fire near Yosemite National Park, now 30% contained, has grown to about 300 square miles.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC Bay Area](<http://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/Rim-Fire-Near-Yosemite-Now-30-Percent-Contained-192500-Acres-Burnedound-on-Rim-Fire-Near-Yosemite-Now-20-Percent-Contained-221627691.html>).

Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon told the five permanent Security Council members that it may be two weeks before final results of an analysis of samples experts collected at the site of a chemical weapons attack last week in Syria are ready, diplomats said on Friday.

<a id="event-2013-11-17-3-4"></a>

<a id="event-2013-11-23-1-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Computer Weekly retrospectively describes One Direction's seven-hour livestream on November 23, 2013.

Editorial date: 2013-11-23. Checked: 2026-10-22. The account supports the event, date and duration described as seven hours, not strictly more than seven, and does not independently establish the album-promotion clause.

Evidence: [Computer Weekly](<https://www.computerweekly.com/news/2240228060/Sony-Music-Google-cloud-One-Directions-1D-Day-event-platform-services>).

Original source account: 1D day premieres live all over the world for over seven hours to celebrate the release of One Direction's new album, Midnight Memories.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2013-11-25-4-2"></a>

Context: Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting:.

**Archived source account.** The official intermediate report on the shooting is released online, totaling 48 pages, and detailing no clear motive for the shooting. It states that perpetrator Adam Lanza had had an obsession with shootings like Columbine, had a strained and non-communicative relationship with his murdered mother Nancy, and had planned the shooting and the details in advance. It does say he had mental health issues, but does not indicate they were causative factors. \{\{Dead link\|date=April 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2013/11/25/justice/sandy-hook-shooting-report/index.html?hpt=hp_t2>); [News 12 Connecticut](<http://connecticut.news12.com/news/sandy-hook-elementary-school-shooting-summary-report-to-be-released-today-1.6492131>).

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The IFJ/EFJ reported police cutting Canal Nou's broadcast signal around midday on November 29.

Editorial date: 2013-11-29. Checked: 2026-10-22. This participant organization's statement supports closure and police involvement. It does not substantiate the exact 12:19 AM GMT time or 23-year duration; the midnight wording is not reconciled by guessing.

Evidence: [International and European Federations of Journalists](<https://www.ifj.org/es/sala-de-prensa/noticias/detalle/article/ifjefj-strongly-support-spanish-unions-against-brutal-closure-of-rtv-valencia-nou-in-spain>).

Original source account: Spanish channel Canal Nou cease broadcasting when the police pull the plug at 12:19 AM GMT, ending its 23 years of broadcasting.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Evidence: [US Department of State via ecoi.net](<https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/1126432.html>).

Original source account: An alert passenger averts a mass casualty bus bombing

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2013-12-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin broke with a long tradition of Soviet and Russian heads of state and delivered two New Year’s speeches instead of one. The second New Year’s address was made from Khabarovsk, a far-eastern city hit by devastating floods in summer, instead of the Moscow Kremlin.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA](<http://en.ria.ru/russia/20131231/186123925/Putin-Makes-2-New-Years-Speeches-for-2014.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/putin-travels-east-comments-on-terror-attacks/2013/12/31/1f6dace0-7243-11e3-8def-a33011492df2_story.html>).

#### Law, crime and accidents

<a id="event-2013-12-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of protestors gather at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur to begin protests against the Malaysian government's introduction of price hikes.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/thousands-protest-price/939744.html>).

<a id="event-2013-12-31-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire was set in the stairway of a gay nightclub in Seattle on New Year's Eve which was quickly extinguished. An empty gasoline container was found at the top of the stairway.

Source citations (as archived): [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2014/01/02/seattle-gay-bar-fire-_n_4531451.html>).
